name: ParallaxColumns
description: Three masonry columns of gradient tiles pinned inside their own smooth-scroll viewport; scrolling drives each column at a different speed while the middle column counter-moves, under a frosted title card.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" labelled by the title, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrow/Page keys/Space (native, unsmoothed) with a 2px :focus-visible outline. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move; at the edges wheel events are released to the page, and touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. The tile columns are decorative and aria-hidden; the title is a real heading. Under prefers-reduced-motion the wheel is not intercepted and the columns stay still.

defaultProps.title: A gallery that moves with you

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Heading on the frosted card over the columns; an empty string hides the card.

propsApi.name: tilesPerColumn
propsApi.description: Number of gradient tiles in each of the three columns.

propsApi.name: gap
propsApi.description: Gap in px between columns and tiles.

propsApi.name: speed
propsApi.description: Travel speed of the outer columns as a fraction (0..1) of their available distance; the right column moves at 55% of the left.

propsApi.name: counterMiddle
propsApi.description: Move the middle column in the opposite direction (downward) as you scroll.

propsApi.name: palette
propsApi.description: Colors cycled through the tile gradients.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
